create-1000-files.name: create 1000 files
create-1000-files.command: for i in $(seq 1 1000); do echo $i > f$i; done

stat-1000-files.name: stat 1000 files
stat-1000-files.command: for i in $(seq 1 1000); do echo $i > f$i; done; for i in $(seq 1 1000); do stat f$i; done

rm-1000-files.name: rm 1000 files
rm-1000-files.command: for i in $(seq 1 1000); do echo $i > f$i; done; rm f*

mkdir-tree.name: mkdir tree (10x10x10)
mkdir-tree.command: for a in $(seq 1 10); do for b in $(seq 1 10); do mkdir -p $a/$b; for c in $(seq 1 10); do touch $a/$b/$c; done; done; done

find-tree.name: find tree
find-tree.command: for a in $(seq 1 10); do for b in $(seq 1 10); do mkdir -p $a/$b; for c in $(seq 1 10); do touch $a/$b/$c; done; done; done; find . -type f | wc -l

write-64-mib.name: write 64 MiB
write-64-mib.command: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none

copy-64-mib.name: copy 64 MiB
copy-64-mib.command: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none; cp big big2

read-64-mib.name: read 64 MiB
read-64-mib.command: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none; cat big > /dev/null

pure-read-64-mib.name: pure read 64 MiB
pure-read-64-mib.prep: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none

pure-copy-64-mib.name: pure copy 64 MiB
pure-copy-64-mib.prep: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none

overwrite-64-mib.name: overwrite 64 MiB
overwrite-64-mib.prep: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none
overwrite-64-mib.command: dd if=/dev/zero of=big bs=1M count=64 status=none conv=notrunc

git-init-commit-100-files.name: git init + commit 100 files
git-init-commit-100-files.command: git init -q; for i in $(seq 1 100); do echo $i > f$i; done; git add -A; git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -qm init

timer: inside admitted container: exact command start through pullOnce, WAL checkpoint, database fsync, and authority-directory fsync
verification: pre-timed restart/rehydration plus post-ack SIGKILL, same-container restart, fresh DB process, reconcile/push, exact native-FUSE manifest
resources: whole-cgroup CPU <= 1.05*T_to_durable+5ms per measured sample; aggregate CFS throttled/wall <=5%; memory peak <=512MiB; OOM/kill zero; exact cpu.max and memory.max; terminal container/volume zero
